baseline: Hi + bilinear bounded fixture; no changes to geometry, UVs, ROI or threshold
requirement: Change exactly one scalar each time; render; compare to original and require strictly larger fixed-ROI error; restore exact input bytes and hash; re-render restored baseline and require identical PNG hash before next mutation
limitation: Significant perturbations prove field influence in this fixture. They do not establish bit-exact numeric precision, every runtime camera mode, clipping planes, or control speed. Elevation is intentionally excluded because the captured zero-zoom case ignores it.
